text.description_html:
Weslock Single Cylinder Handleset Utica Lever Interior Trim

This is a single cylinder interior time set to be used with the Weslock Woodward Handleset or the Weslock Belmont Handleset. It comes packaged as the interior trim only with the Utica Lever.

Features and Specifications of the Interior Utica Lever for Woodward or Belmont Handlesets:

  • Length: 10-1/8"
  • Width: 2-3/4"
  • Projection: 2-3/4"

Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS.
